1.The unaudited Consolidated financial results of Genesys International Corporation Limited ('GICL') ('The Parent company") and Its subsidiaries (together referred as 'Group'} have been prepared In accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (lnd AS) notified under section 133 oil he Companies Act, 2013, read together with the companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules 2015 (as amended and other accounting principle generally accepted In India and In compliance With Regulation 33 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), 2015 as & amended.

2.The unaudited Consolidated financial results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on 13 November 2026. These unaudited Consolidated financial results have been subjected to limited review by the statutory auditors of the Company and they have expressed an unmodified review conclusion on these unaudited Consolidated financial results. The above unaudited financial results of the Company are available on the Company's website (www.igenesys.com.com} and stock exchanges websites, BSE (www.bselndia.com} and NSE (www.nselndia.com), where the shares of the Company are listed.

3.On 17th May 2025, the Company has, by way of Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) In accordance with SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, as amended and section 42 and 62 of the Companies Act, 2013, allotted 17, 39,625 equity shares of face value of Rs. 5 per share at a price of Rs. 632.32 per share, aggregating to Rs.11,000 lakhs. The utlisation of QIP funds till 30th Sept 26 was 4561.04 Lakhs with a balance outstanding of
Rs.6438.96 Lakhs.

During the quarter, the QIP funds withdrawn have been utilized in accordance with the 'Use of Proceeds' mentioned in the placement document of QIP except for an amount of Rs. 660 lakhs which was utilised for purposes other than those specified in the offer document, which has been transferred back to the monitoring account from the current account during the quarter.

During the period, in AGM conducted on 30th Sept 2026, the Company proposed to revise the objects of utilisation of the QIP proceeds, In accordance with the applicable regulatory and statutory requirements. Out of the balance 6438.96 Lakhs • an amount of Rs.2438.96 Lakhs will be utilised towards continued development of the technology platform and creation/updation of map content as originally planned with an extension till March 2028. Further, the balance of Rs.4000 Lakhs is proposed towards repayment of bank Loan which is expected to reduce the Company's outstanding borrowings.

4.The figures for the quarter ended 30 September 2026is the balancing figures between unaudited figures in respect of the half financial year and the unaudited published year to date figures up to quarter ended 30 June 2026 which were subject to limited review by the statutory auditors.

5.The Group operates only in one Primary segment i.e. GIS based services, hence disclosure as per IND PS 108 'Operating segment' Is not required.

6. Pursuant to the Board of Directors approval dated June 26, 2026 for issue of equity shares by way of Rights Issue ("Rights Issue), the Company had filed Letter of Offer on July 31, 2026. The Rights Issue Committee of the Board of Directors, approved the terms of the rights issue, including the Issue price of Rs 50 per fully paid-up equity share (including a premium of Rs 45 per equity share), the rights entitlement ratio of 3 (Three) fully paid-up equity shares for every 5 (Five) fully paid-up equity shares held by the eligible equity shareholders of the Company as on the record date, and an aggregate Issue of up to 2,50,74,226fully paid-up equity shares aggregating to approximately Rs.12537 Lakhs. The record date for determining the eligibility of shareholders was fixed as 6 August 2026, and the rights issue opened on 14 August 2026 and closed on 21 August 2026.

As per the objects of the issue, the company has raised an amount of Rs.11048 Lakhs and an amount of Rs.1489lakhs was adjusted towards extinguishment of unsecured Loan of promoter.

7. Previous period figures have been re-grouped I re-classified, wherever necessary.
